name: Once an Artist
source:
Dean used to be a professional artist, until the day his father became ill 6 years ago. He gave up his career and took care of his father, but had lost the taste and joy for art. Upon a visit to his mother whom he used to live with, his drawings started to speak to him...

[From [url=http://mayshing.com/GAME/artist/artist.htm]official site[/url]]
translation:
Dean used to be a professional artist, until the day his father became ill 6 years ago. He gave up his career and took care of his father, but had lost the taste and joy for art. Upon a visit to his mother whom he used to live with, his drawings started to speak to him...
